links.outcome: Generalization to held-out datasets from different clinical sites (MIMIC-IV and JHU PMAP)
links.effect: Model trained on public data generalized to held-out MIMIC-IV and the private JHU PMAP dataset; overall balanced accuracy 71.3% and F1 0.349 across benchmark.
links.quote: The model trained on public clinical dataonly generalized to the both the held-out MIMIC-IV and the private JHU PMAP dataset collected at Johns Hopkins Universityhospital.

unlisted_practices: Training multimodal reasoning models to reduce extrinsic hallucination (78.2% reduction after training)

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates multimodal clinical reasoning foundation models across held-out datasets (evaluating generalizability, cross-site transferability, and hallucination reduction), but it only performs benchmark evaluation of a newly developed model architecture rather than testing deployment practices or safeguards.
